## Architecture

### Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Frontend | Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS (no build step) |
| Scoring | Pure JS engine — `scoring-engine.js` + `scoring-data.js` |
| Design | Inter font, warm clinical palette (cream/earth tones) |
| Delivery | EmailJS (client-side, no server) |
| Hosting | GitHub Pages (static files) |
| CI/CD | GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`) |

### File Map

```
assessment-ui/
├── CLAUDE.md                    ← This file (project command center)
├── README.md                    ← GitHub-facing documentation
├── docs/
│   └── SOP.md                   ← Operational playbook
│
├── client.html                  ← CLIENT-FACING assessment + reflection
├── client-reflections.js        ← Reflection logic, safety checks, EmailJS delivery
├── index.html                   ← CLINICIAN-FACING scoring dashboard

│

└── .gitignore
```

### Two-App Architecture

The system has two completely separate user experiences sharing the same scoring engine:

| | Client (`client.html`) | Clinician (`index.html`) |
|---|---|---|
| **Audience** | Patients via text/email link | Brian (in-office or remote) |
| **Assessment** | Same 567/370 items, same UX | Same |
| **Post-scoring** | Guided reflection (no clinical data) | Full T-scores, tables, charts |
| **Delivery** | EmailJS sends report to Brian | On-screen only |
| **Safety** | 988 crisis banner when DSI endorsed | Critical items with item text |
| **Name collection** | Yes (first name, last initial) | No |

### Scoring Engine

**`scoring-engine.js`** — Pure functions, no DOM. `(answers, config) → results`

- `scoreInstrument()` — Main entry point
- `scoreKeyedScale()` — Handles K-correction (0.5K for Hs, 0.4K for Pd, 1.0K for Pt/Sc, 0.2K for Ma)
- `scoreInconsistency()` — VRIN/TRIN pair matching
- `scoreCriticalItems()` — 10 critical item groups
- `profileElevation()` — Mean T of Hs, D, Hy, Pd, Pa, Pt, Sc, Ma

**`scoring-data.js`** — Immutable data (version `2025-01`)

- 6 validity scales (L, F, Fb, Fp, K, S)
- 10 clinical scales (Hs through Si, with Mf gender-variant)
- 15 content scales (ANX through TRT)
- 7 supplementary scales (A, R, Es, MAC-R, AAS, APS, MDS)
- 2 inconsistency scales (VRIN: 67 rules, TRIN: 23 rules)
- 10 critical item groups (Koss-Butcher & Lachar-Wrobel)
- Gender-specific transform tables for all scales

### Client Reflection Logic

**`client-reflections.js`** — Maps scoring output to warm, non-clinical themes

- `generateReflection()` — Orchestrator: tone + themes + safety
- `getOverallTone()` — Profile elevation → 4 tone bands (high/moderate/mild/normal)
- `CRITICAL_GROUP_REFLECTIONS` — 10 groups → gentle sentences
- `CLINICAL_SCALE_THEMES` — T≥65 scales → broad themes (deduplicated with critical groups)
- `checkSuicidalIdeation()` — DSI detection, high-risk item flagging (506, 520, 524)
- `submitReport()` — EmailJS delivery + localStorage fallback
- `buildClinicianReport()` — Full JSON report for email

## Conventions

### Code

- No build step — all vanilla HTML/CSS/JS
- Scoring engine is pure functions, no DOM dependency
- Scale data is immutable, versioned (`2025-01`)
- K-correction order matters: K must be scored before K-corrected scales
- Transform tables use +1 offset: `tScore = transform[raw + 1]`
- Gender-variant scale (Mf) has separate keyed items per gender
- All item numbers are 1-based (matching booklet), array indices are 0-based

### Design

- CSS variables are the single source of truth for the design system
- Inter font family throughout
- Color carries meaning: green = normal/true, warm-red = elevated/false, gold = borderline
- No neon, no glow, no glassmorphism — purposeful, clinical, warm
- `prefers-reduced-motion` respected

### Safety

- DSI critical items trigger 988 crisis banner automatically
- Items 506, 520, 524 are high-risk SI (not administered in short form)
- Safety flags included in every clinician report
- Crisis banner is calm teal, not alarming red
- Client never sees clinical terminology, T-scores, or scale names

### Deploy

- `git push` to main → GitHub Actions auto-deploys (~20s)
- No build step needed — static files served directly
- All secrets (EmailJS keys) are in client-side JS (acceptable for this use case)

## Decision Log

| Decision | Rationale |
|----------|-----------|
| Vanilla JS, no framework | Zero build step, instant deploy, no dependency risk for clinical tool |
| EmailJS over Google Sheets | Sheets webhook had CORS/auth issues; EmailJS is 3 lines of code, works instantly |
| Client reflection instead of scores | Clients should not self-interpret T-scores; warm themes encourage provider discussion |
| Separate client.html vs index.html | Complete separation of concerns — no risk of client accidentally seeing clinician view |
| K-correction in scoring engine | Matches legacy reference implementation exactly (multiplier detection + +1 indexing) |
| 988 crisis banner on any DSI endorsement | Conservative — even one DSI item warrants showing crisis resources |
| Profile elevation = mean of 8 scales | Standard definition (Hs, D, Hy, Pd, Pa, Pt, Sc, Ma), excludes Mf and Si |
| Short form caps at item 370 | Standard abbreviated form; items above 370 are not scored |
| No server, no database | Clinical data stays in the email — no PHI stored on any server |
